working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineage 8B (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any hemilineage B (Notch OFF) neuron that develops from neuroblast NB3-3 during the postembryonic phase of neurogenesis. In the adult, these neurons are cholinergic (Lacin et al., 2019).

justification: The authors' predicted hemilineage 8B (lineage markers and fast-acting neurotransmitter, Figure 4): its secondary (postembryonic) neurons.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00051468 hemilineage 8B secondary neuron (exact match).
